{{Top|leg}}
The '''New Republic Medical Institute''' was a medical research and education facility founded on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|376|New Republic Medical Institute}}</ref> At some point, [[Kirk Takill]] served as the manager of medical research at the Institute, with a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] named [[Darkin]] working as a researcher.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
